# Features block

> Feature grids and highlights.

Install doc for the **Features block** of ui-kit: 3 variants built only from ui-kit components. React >=18.2 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4.

## Instructions for the AI agent

Add the Features block to this project exactly as specified here. If the user did not say which variant, ask, or install the first one.

1. **Setup first.** Look for `ui/styles/kit.css` in the folder the `@/` import alias points to (`src/` in most Next.js apps, otherwise the project root). If it is missing, apply the one-time setup first: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/setup.md
2. **Install these components first**, in this order, skipping any already in `ui/components/`. Follow each one's doc, or run the download script below, which covers all of them:
   - `badge`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/badge.md
3. **Shared files.** Create the files under [Shared files](#shared-files) at their exact paths (the download script covers them).
4. **Register the CSS.** In `ui/styles/kit.css`, add this line directly above the `@source` line, skipping any already there:

   ```css
   @import "./components/badge.css";
   ```

5. **Create the block.** Save the variant verbatim as its own file, for example `components/blocks/features/<variant>.tsx` inside the `@/` folder, then render it from a page. Change the copy (names, prices, links) only if the user asks.

**Rules.** Copy every file verbatim: do not restyle, rename classes, reformat, "improve", convert to another styling approach (CSS modules, styled-components, inline styles) or add npm packages. React and Tailwind CSS v4 only. Keep `'use client'` lines where they are. If a file already exists with identical contents, leave it. Fetch this doc and the source files as raw text (for example with `curl`), not through a summarising web reader: the code must arrive character for character.

## Specification

### Block: Features

A landing-page section that explains what the product does: a short header, then the features themselves as a grid, a bento of illustrated tiles, or alternating text-and-visual rows. A marketing block: kit components plus Tailwind utilities, no new `ui-*` classes.

#### Variants
```
icon-grid     eyebrow · h2 | lead (side by side on lg) · 6 features in 1/2/3 columns, each with a hairline top border
bento         eyebrow · h2 · lead · 5 tiles on a 6-column grid (one 4×2 hero tile), each with a decorative mini-visual
alternating   h2 · lead · 3 rows: copy (eyebrow, h3, body, checklist, link) beside a framed visual, sides swap per row
```

#### Anatomy
```
<section>                       rounded-2xl border bg-background, px 20 → 32px, py 56 → 80px
  header                        <p> eyebrow (text-primary-text, 13px/500) · <h2> · <p> lead
  <ul ref> .ui-stagger          the one staggered group, revealed when scrolled into view
    <li>                        icon tile 40px (rounded-lg border bg-muted, 20px Icon) · <h3> · <p>
```
Bento tile: `<li class="flex flex-col rounded-2xl border bg-card p-5 sm:p-6">` → `<h3>` · `<p>` · `<div aria-hidden class="mt-auto pt-6">` visual. Spans: `sm:col-span-2 lg:col-span-4 lg:row-span-2` for the first tile, then `lg:col-span-2`, `lg:col-span-2`, `lg:col-span-3`, `lg:col-span-3`.
Alternating row: `grid lg:grid-cols-2 gap-8 lg:gap-16`; odd rows put the copy second with `lg:order-2`. The visual is a `role="img"` frame: `rounded-2xl border bg-muted/40 p-3 sm:p-6` with a radial series tint, holding a `rounded-xl border bg-card p-4` mock.

#### Visual rules
- h2: `font-display` 28px → 40px from `sm`, 600, `tracking-tight`. h3: 17px/600 (grid, bento) or 24 → 28px (alternating).
- Body: 15px `text-muted-foreground`, left-aligned, never balanced.
- Grid gaps: icon grid `gap-x-8 gap-y-10`; bento `gap-3`, `gap-4` from `lg`.
- Mini-visuals use semantic fills only: `bg-series-1/2/5` for data, `bg-success`/`bg-warning`/`bg-destructive` for status, `bg-muted` tracks, `bg-primary` for an "on" toggle.
- Subtle gradients only: one tinted tile in the bento (`series-1` 12%), and the alternating frames (`series-n` 13%).
- Checklist icons: `check` 18px in `text-success-text`.

#### Motion
- One orchestrated entrance per block: the list gets `.ui-stagger` the first time it is 10% inside the viewport (IntersectionObserver, then disconnect). Until then it carries `motion-safe:opacity-0`, so with reduced motion it is never hidden.
- Link arrows nudge 2px on hover.
- Reduced motion: no hiding, and the global rule makes the entrance instant.

#### Accessibility
- Section heading is an `<h2>`; each feature is an `<h3>` inside a list item.
- Decorative visuals are `aria-hidden` (bento) or a single `role="img"` with a descriptive label (alternating).
- Icons beside text are decorative (`aria-hidden`, the kit's default).

#### Responsive
- 360px: one column everywhere; bento tiles stack; alternating rows put the copy above the visual.
- `sm`: 2 columns (icon grid, bento). `lg`: 3 columns / 6-column bento / side-by-side rows.
- No horizontal overflow: long mono labels truncate.

#### Acceptance checks
- The list is visible after scrolling into view, and immediately with reduced motion.
- No horizontal overflow at 360px; axe reports no serious violations.

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Icon, type IconName } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

const FEATURES: { icon: IconName; title: string; body: string }[] = [
  {
    icon: 'zap',
    title: 'Progressive rollouts',
    body: 'Ship to 1%, then 10%, then everyone. Each step waits for your health checks before it moves on.',
  },
  {
    icon: 'activity',
    title: 'Automatic health checks',
    body: 'Error rate, latency and saturation are compared with the last good release, not a static threshold.',
  },
  {
    icon: 'refresh-cw',
    title: 'One-click rollback',
    body: 'Restore the previous version in every region at once. Average rollback time across customers: 38 seconds.',
  },
  {
    icon: 'bell',
    title: 'Paging that respects sleep',
    body: 'Alerts are grouped by cause and routed to whoever owns the service, with quiet hours for everything else.',
  },
  {
    icon: 'lock',
    title: 'Approvals and audit log',
    body: 'Require a second reviewer for production, and keep a signed record of who shipped what and when.',
  },
  {
    icon: 'bar-chart',
    title: 'DORA metrics, built in',
    body: 'Deploy frequency, lead time, change failure rate and recovery time, tracked per team from day one.',
  },
];

/** Plays the kit's stagger entrance once, when the group first scrolls into view. */
function useReveal<T extends HTMLElement>() {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') {
      setShown(true);
      return;
    }
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        if (entries.some((e) => e.isIntersecting)) {
          setShown(true);
          observer.disconnect();
        }
      },
      { rootMargin: '0px 0px -10% 0px' },
    );
    observer.observe(el);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return [ref, shown] as const;
}

export default function FeaturesIconGrid() {
  const [gridRef, shown] = useReveal<HTMLUListElement>();

  return (
    <section className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background px-5 py-14 sm:px-8 sm:py-20">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl">
        <div className="grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-2 lg:items-end lg:gap-16">
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-primary-text">Platform</p>
            <h2 className="mt-3 font-display text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight sm:text-5xl">
              Everything between merge and production.
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="max-w-xl text-md text-muted-foreground sm:text-lg">
            Halcyon replaces the deploy script, the flag service and the on-call spreadsheet with one tool your whole
            team already understands.
          </p>
        </div>

        <ul
          ref={gridRef}
          className={`mt-12 grid gap-x-8 gap-y-10 sm:mt-16 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 ${shown ? 'ui-stagger' : 'motion-safe:opacity-0'}`}
        >
          {FEATURES.map((f) => (
            <li key={f.title} className="border-t border-border pt-6">
              <span className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted text-foreground">
                <Icon name={f.icon} size={20} />
              </span>
              <h3 className="mt-5 text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">{f.title}</h3>
              <p className="mt-2 text-md text-muted-foreground">{f.body}</p>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

const STAGES = ['1%', '10%', '50%', '100%'];
/** Rollout progress per region: finished stages, plus how far into the current one (0–1). */
const REGIONS = [
  { name: 'eu-west-1', done: 3, current: 0.7 },
  { name: 'us-east-1', done: 2, current: 0.4 },
  { name: 'ap-south-1', done: 1, current: 0.9 },
];

const FLAGS = [
  { key: 'new-checkout', rollout: '25%', on: true },
  { key: 'smart-retry', rollout: '100%', on: true },
  { key: 'dark-launch-search', rollout: '0%', on: false },
];

/** 45 days of uptime: one bar per day; the incidents are on day 17 and 35. */
const UPTIME = Array.from({ length: 45 }, (_, i) => (i === 17 ? 'bg-warning' : i === 35 ? 'bg-destructive' : 'bg-success'));

const INTEGRATIONS = ['GitHub', 'Slack', 'Datadog', 'Terraform', 'PagerDuty', 'Jira', 'Sentry', 'Grafana'];

function useReveal<T extends HTMLElement>() {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') {
      setShown(true);
      return;
    }
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        if (entries.some((e) => e.isIntersecting)) {
          setShown(true);
          observer.disconnect();
        }
      },
      { rootMargin: '0px 0px -10% 0px' },
    );
    observer.observe(el);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return [ref, shown] as const;
}

function Tile({ title, body, className = '', style, children }: { title: string; body: string; className?: string; style?: CSSProperties; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <li className={`flex min-w-0 flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-5 sm:p-6 ${className}`} style={style}>
      <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">{title}</h3>
      <p className="mt-1.5 max-w-md text-md text-muted-foreground">{body}</p>
      <div className="mt-auto pt-6" aria-hidden="true">
        {children}
      </div>
    </li>
  );
}

export default function FeaturesBento() {
  const [gridRef, shown] = useReveal<HTMLUListElement>();

  return (
    <section className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background px-5 py-14 sm:px-8 sm:py-20">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl">
        <div className="max-w-2xl">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-primary-text">Why teams switch</p>
          <h2 className="mt-3 font-display text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight sm:text-5xl">Release safely, at any scale.</h2>
          <p className="mt-4 text-md text-muted-foreground sm:text-lg">
            The guardrails big platform teams build in-house, ready on day one for a team of five.
          </p>
        </div>

        <ul
          ref={gridRef}
          className={`mt-12 grid gap-3 sm:mt-14 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-6 lg:gap-4 ${shown ? 'ui-stagger' : 'motion-safe:opacity-0'}`}
        >
          <Tile
            title="Region-by-region rollouts"
            body="Each region moves through the stages on its own clock and pauses by itself when its health checks disagree."
            className="sm:col-span-2 lg:col-span-4 lg:row-span-2"
          >
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border p-3 sm:p-4">
              <div className="grid items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-2 sm:grid-cols-[6rem_1fr] sm:gap-y-3">
                <span className="hidden sm:block" />
                <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                  {STAGES.map((s) => (
                    <span key={s}>{s}</span>
                  ))}
                </div>
                {REGIONS.map((r) => (
                  <div key={r.name} className="contents">
                    <span className="truncate font-mono text-xs">{r.name}</span>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1.5">
                      {STAGES.map((s, i) => (
                        <span key={s} className="h-2.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted">
                          <span
                            className="block h-full rounded-full bg-series-1"
                            style={{ width: i < r.done ? '100%' : i === r.done ? `${r.current * 100}%` : '0%' }}
                          />
                        </span>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-1 border-t border-border pt-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="size-2 rounded-full bg-success" /> Error rate 0.02%
                </span>
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="size-2 rounded-full bg-success" /> p95 214ms
                </span>
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="size-2 rounded-full bg-success" /> Saturation 41%
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </Tile>

          <Tile title="Feature flags" body="Decouple deploy from release. Target by plan, region or a single customer." className="lg:col-span-2">

              <span>45 days ago</span>
              <span className="tabular-nums">99.98% uptime</span>
            </div>

### Alternating rows

'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Badge } from '@/ui/components/badge';
import { Icon, type IconName } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

function useReveal<T extends HTMLElement>() {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') {
      setShown(true);
      return;
    }
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        if (entries.some((e) => e.isIntersecting)) {
          setShown(true);
          observer.disconnect();
        }
      },
      { rootMargin: '0px 0px -10% 0px' },
    );
    observer.observe(el);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return [ref, shown] as const;
}

/** The visual frame: a quiet well with a subtle gradient, the mock card inside it. */
function Frame({ label, hue, children }: { label: string; hue: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div
      role="img"
      aria-label={label}
      className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-muted/40 p-3 sm:p-6"
      style={{ backgroundImage: `radial-gradient(70% 70% at 30% 0%, color-mix(in oklch, var(${hue}) 13%, transparent), transparent 70%)` }}
    >
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-4">{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

function RolloutVisual() {
  const steps = [
    { label: 'Canary · 1%', state: 'done', note: '4 min' },
    { label: 'Early · 10%', state: 'done', note: '12 min' },
    { label: 'Half · 50%', state: 'active', note: 'Checking' },
    { label: 'Everyone · 100%', state: 'waiting', note: 'Waiting' },
  ];
  return (
    <Frame label="A release moving through four rollout stages, halfway done" hue="--ui-series-1">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <p className="font-mono text-sm">v4.12.0</p>
        <Badge variant="info" size="sm" dot>
          Rolling out
        </Badge>
      </div>
      <ol className="mt-4 grid gap-3">
        {steps.map((s) => (
          <li key={s.label} className="flex items-center gap-3 text-sm">
            <span
              className={`grid size-5 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full ${
                s.state === 'done' ? 'bg-success text-success-foreground' : s.state === 'active' ? 'border-2 border-info' : 'border border-border'
              }`}
            >
              {s.state === 'done' && <Icon name="check" size={12} strokeWidth={2.5} />}
            </span>
            <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{s.label}</span>
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{s.note}</span>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
    </Frame>
  );
}

function FlagsVisual() {

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">

        <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground">

      <p className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        <Icon name="clock" size={14} />
        Hand-off Wednesday 09:00, with a summary of open alerts
      </p>
    </Frame>
  );
}

const ROWS: { icon: IconName; eyebrow: string; title: string; body: string; points: string[]; visual: ReactNode }[] = [
  {
    icon: 'zap',
    eyebrow: 'Rollouts',
    title: 'Watch every release land, stage by stage.',
    body: 'Pick the stages once. Halcyon moves each release forward only when error rate and latency match the version it replaces.',
    points: ['Health checks between every stage', 'Pause, resume or roll back from Slack', 'Per-region schedules and freeze windows'],
    visual: <RolloutVisual />,
  },
  {
    icon: 'filter',
    eyebrow: 'Feature flags',
    title: 'Turn features on for exactly the right people.',
    body: 'Ship dark, then target by plan, region or account. Flags evaluate locally in under a millisecond, so they never slow a request.',
    points: ['Targeting rules anyone on the team can read', 'Percentage rollouts with sticky assignment', 'Stale flag reminders after 30 days'],
    visual: <FlagsVisual />,
  },
  {
    icon: 'users',
    eyebrow: 'On-call',
    title: 'Hand-offs that never drop the pager.',
    body: 'Rotations, overrides and escalation in one calendar. Every hand-off comes with a short summary of what is still open.',
    points: ['Follow-the-sun rotations across time zones', 'Overrides in two taps from your phone', 'Fair-load reports for every team'],
    visual: <OnCallVisual />,
  },
];

export default function FeaturesAlternating() {
  const [listRef, shown] = useReveal<HTMLDivElement>();

  return (
    <section className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background px-5 py-14 sm:px-8 sm:py-20">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl">
        <div className="max-w-2xl">
          <h2 className="font-display text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight sm:text-5xl">One workflow, from merge to morning.</h2>
          <p className="mt-4 text-md text-muted-foreground sm:text-lg">
            Three tools most teams glue together by hand, designed to work as one.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div ref={listRef} className={`mt-14 grid gap-16 sm:mt-20 sm:gap-24 ${shown ? 'ui-stagger' : 'motion-safe:opacity-0'}`}>
          {ROWS.map((row, i) => (
            <div key={row.eyebrow} className="grid items-center gap-8 lg:grid-cols-2 lg:gap-16">
              <div className={`min-w-0 ${i % 2 === 1 ? 'lg:order-2' : ''}`}>
                <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium text-primary-text">
                  <Icon name={row.icon} />
                  {row.eyebrow}
                </p>
                <h3 className="mt-3 font-display text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight sm:text-3xl">{row.title}</h3>
                <p className="mt-4 text-md text-muted-foreground">{row.body}</p>
                <ul className="mt-6 grid gap-2.5">
                  {row.points.map((p) => (
                    <li key={p} className="flex gap-3 text-md">
                      <Icon name="check" size={18} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-success-text" />
                      {p}
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
                <a
                  href="#"
                  className="group mt-6 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-primary-text hover:underline hover:underline-offset-4"
                >
                  Learn about {row.eyebrow.toLowerCase()}
                  <Icon name="arrow-right" size={14} className="transition-transform duration-150 group-hover:translate-x-0.5" />
                </a>
              </div>
              <div className={`min-w-0 ${i % 2 === 1 ? 'lg:order-1' : ''}`}>{row.visual}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```
